confidence: Chebyshev radius sqrt(Vmax/alpha) expands [H_L,H_U], clipped to1..5; at least95% over declared independent form allocation conditional on fixed roster/reference answers, under arbitrary incidental missingness. Not a posterior interval or evidence of actual protocol.
design_status: explicit conditional design contract; recorded forms and frequencies alone do not prove this allocation law. Prior source audit describes randomized forms, but a reader needs the actual assignment protocol to justify coverage.
estimator: H_i = (keyed wb1 + keyed wb2 + 1.5 times sum of the two scheduled rotated wb3/wb4/wb5) /5. Original form design weights, never observed form shares. With incidental scheduled blanks H_i is unknown and bounded, not imputed.
form_design: independent uniform choices among forms1,2,3 across the fixed six-month respondent roster; independent of fixed reference answers; no form effect on response membership or item values
incidental_bounds: Every unavailable scheduled keyed item is assigned1/5 for lower/upper H_i. Planned omissions receive no response weight. Average over all956 respondents. Preserve all1219 audited rows; H fields blank for nonrespondents.
logical_support: Full five-item mean support separately counts all unavailable target items, including planned omissions. Also report all-randomized six-month logical support as a different population, without design interval.
precision_comparison: conditional form-allocation variance versus a fully measured fixed census, whose variance is zero. Relative precision-loss percentage is undefined; no universal correlation or burden ranking.
prior_knowledge: All preceding ordinary results/design descriptions, existing956 respondents and312/317/327 forms known before freeze. The pair-square bound and small-fixture hand derivations (target3, mixed variance13/400, selective mixed H2.7, unequal-block target3.4) were derived before scripted computation. Not blind preregistration. No complete/hidden/reveal Tonmick outcomes or World files used.
reporting: Question, Target, Link, Estimation, Claim Audit; separate observation components, uncertainty types, diagnostics and model warnings; document actual versions/commands/tapes, revisions and future evidence.
target: finite full five-item wellbeing mean at six months among actual six-month survey respondents, equal person weights; conditional design teaching target, not B8-T01/T02/T03
toy_design: 4 fixed people per fixture, exhaustive81 independent uniform form assignments, equal probabilities; a separate deterministic rule omits each largest rotated item, breaking the uniform design; ties choose smallest form
variance: Conditional on fixed full responses, Var(Hbar)=sum_i sum_{j<k in rotated}(yij-yik)^2/(100*N^2). Each pair-square sum <=32, so Vmax=8/(25*N). No hidden values used to estimate actual design variance.
variance_estimator_teaching: For complete teaching inputs, Vhat=3*sum_i(difference of the two scheduled rotated keyed items)^2/(100*N^2). Check expectation by all3^4 assignments; do not drop unavailable real pairs to create an ordinary variance estimate.
